name: Michi De Angelis
source:
Coming from a low income family, Michi plans to use his knowledge of spiritual items in order to establish commerce with those who are interested in haunted items to bring his family out of poverty.

After graduation he hopes to get an internship with famous spiritual merchant, Neo Marcello

[From the official Character sheet.]
